title: Rural health grant for kūpuna leaving the hospital
summary: As of the September 8 meeting, the rural health funds must be encumbered, or committed, by September 30th. The program being funded will link older adults leaving the hospital with a community health worker for 90 days.

timeline.text: The rural health funds must be encumbered, or committed, by September 30th.
The program will link older adults leaving the hospital with a community health worker for 90 days.
Governor Josh Green announced $58 million in federal Rural Health Transformation Program funding for rural and underserved communities across Hawaiʻi.

source.publisher: Office of the Governor, State of Hawaiʻi
source.quote: HONOLULU — Governor Josh Green today announced $58 million in federal funding through the Rural Health Transformation Program (RHTP) to improve access to healthcare and strengthen services in rural and underserved communities across Hawaiʻi.
